structured_facts.statement: The referenced OCP Global Summit showcase ran October 12 through October 15, 2026, in San Jose, California.
The physical showcase consisted of an SST cell and a 3D-printed model of a containerized data-center power architecture.
SolarEdge attributed under-load operation to an engineering-lab conversion stage and said full-path system validation was still underway.
The release includes forward-looking limitations covering development, validation, reliability, commercial availability and adoption.
